tools.name: get-categories
tools.description: List all available event categories (concerts, theatre, exhibitions, festivals, etc.).

tools.name: get-event-details
tools.description: Get full details for a single event by its slug. Returns title, description, dates, location, image, and category.

tools.name: get-events-by-place
tools.description: Get cultural events for a specific place (city or town) in Catalonia. Supports filtering by category and date range.

category.description: Category slug to filter by (e.g. concerts, teatre, exposicions)

tools.name: get-places
tools.description: List available places (cities and towns) in Catalonia that have events.

tools.name: search-events
tools.description: Search for cultural events in Catalonia by keyword. Returns a list of matching events with title, date, location, and URL.
